keySentence: The family worked together to survive.

facts.Page story text 1 (draft, teacher check: The family found useful things on the broken ship. They built a raft together. Everyone helped in their own way. "The family worked together to survive."
facts.Page story text 2 (draft, teacher check: After the storm, the family gathered supplies from the damaged ship. They found tools, food, cloth, and seeds that could help them survive. Father led the effort to build a strong raft from pieces of the ship. Every family member had a job and worked hard together. "The family worked together to survive." When everyone does their part, even impossible tasks become possible.
facts.Page story text 3 (draft, teacher check: When the storm finally passed, the Robinson family discovered their ship had lodged between two rocks. Though the vessel was badly damaged, it contained supplies that would be essential for their survival. The father organized everyone into teams to salvage tools, food, weapons, and building materials. Even the youngest son carried supplies while the mother carefully preserved food and fresh water. "The family worked together to survive." However, they knew the ship could break apart completely at any moment. Because every family member contributed according to their abilities, they worked with remarkable efficiency. Together, they built a sturdy raft and loaded it with everything they needed to start life on the nearby island.
